player_intent: Movement looks and feels like the base SOCOM game while the newer crouch/prone reload and weapon-aim presentations remain available.
acceptance_rule: The canonical operator map routes standing, crouched, prone, turn, roll, dive, and jump locomotion to the base clips; reload and weapon aim remain on the newer AGLS clips; animation root motion never moves the CharacterBody3D.

nodes.role: Owns velocity, collision, stance movement, and move_and_slide.
Consumes movement state and action routes for visual presentation only.

system_delta.reason: Base locomotion clips better preserve the established SOCOM movement silhouette, while the newer AGLS reload and aim clips cover missing crouched/prone weapon actions. Root motion remains visual-only.

current.system: Full AGLS locomotion and action presentation map

candidate.system: Base SOCOM locomotion plus newer AGLS reload and aim actions
candidate.open_evidence: Focused hybrid routing passes. The legacy full operator suite still reports fire ownership, posture-specific M4 reload expectation, modern-locomotion mode, prone continuity, and support-hand presentation mismatches that require separate reconciliation.

visual_check: Run, strafe, crouch-walk, crawl, jump, dive, reload while standing/crouched/prone, and confirm the body never moves from animation root motion.
